keys: Each key unlocks access to a provider. We verify it securely – you see only the slot name and hash; the actual key stays hidden.
modelle: All models your keys currently unlock. “Verified” means we ran them through real test questions.
wahl: Best model per task: high success rate with low latency. p = how often the answer fit, n = number of tests.
organe: The system consists of building blocks: Sensor (Keys), Catalog (Models), Tests, Judge (evaluates), Classifier (detects task type), Selection, Immune System (filters bad models), Planner.
anwendungen: Programs that use models via API-OMNI-BRAIN. Each has its own key – toggle them on or off here.
klasse: Aufgabentypen: code (Programmieren), json (Struktur), de (Deutsch), reason (Logik), long (langer Text), tool (Werkzeug-Aufrufe).
anbieter_neu: For video, image, audio, search, or custom services: enter API address and token. We test access and show what the API can do.
durchreichen: For video, image, or audio APIs, API-OMNI-BRAIN uses a free provider key and passes the response through 1:1.
radar: Searches in the background for new free offers in blogs, releases, and news. All over secure connections only, vetted in a sandbox before saving.
apisuche: Search engine for free APIs. Every hit is checked for warning signs (encryption, certificate, domain age). “Clean” = nothing suspicious found.
usecases: Describe your project in plain sentences. API-OMNI-BRAIN categorizes it, finds matching free APIs, verifies them, and shows what you already have.
quarantaene: All external data (GitHub files, lists, feeds) is first inspected in an isolated sandbox without network access. Suspicious items are deleted and never released.
zyklus: Feeds every 2 hrs, API index weekly, model check 2× per week, new sources daily. Runs only when the machine is idle.
anbieter: The service providing the model (e.g., OpenRouter, Together, own server).
erfolgswahrscheinlichkeit: Share of test questions the model solved correctly. 1.00 = always right, 0.50 = every second one.
routing: Model is automatically selected by the system for suitable tasks. Checked = active in routing.
status_verfuegbar: Model responds and delivers usable results.
status_nicht_verfuegbar: Model does not respond or only returns errors.
status_warnung: Model responds but with issues (e.g., very slow, incomplete).
capability: Model’s primary capability: chat, code, embedding, image, video, audio, search, tool, vision, reasoning.
hash: Short key fingerprint (first 8 chars). For identification only, not a secret.
slot: Internal storage slot for the key in the encrypted file. Like a safe-deposit box number.
platzhalter_token: Paste token here (never shown or logged)
platzhalter_base: Base URL of the API, e.g., https://api.example.com/v1
leer_keys: No keys stored. Add a free AI key to start.
leer_modelle: Will be displayed after key validation.
leer_anwendungen: No applications connected yet. [Add application] [Load examples],
leer_radar: Radar is still running or found nothing new. [Refresh radar] [Load more],
legende_balken: Color bars: green ≥ 70% · yellow ≥ 40% · red < 40% success rate. Number = rate / test count.
meldung_entfernt: Key removed from key file (backup created).
hinweis_routing: Active: Model will be automatically selected for suitable tasks.
hinweis_sicherheit: Key file is stored locally (permissions 600). UI shows only slot and hash.
hinweis_inhaltstest: Only chat is tested for content. Video/image/audio are only checked for reachability (costs credit).
